title: Cutting and notching.
officialText:
In exterior walls and bearing partitions, any wood stud is permitted to be cut or notched to
a depth not exceeding 25 percent of its width. Cutting or notching of studs to a depth not greater than 40 percent of the width
of the stud is permitted in nonbearing partitions supporting no loads other than the weight of the partition.
